text: I was hurt in a car accident in Newcastle. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Newcastle. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
If you were hurt in a car accident in Newcastle, you have access to several reputable local and national compensation law firms that specialize in NSW Compulsory Third Party (CTP) insurance claims, motor vehicle accident injuries, and common law damages.[wmcdlaw.com.au](https://wmcdlaw.com.au/compensation-law/car-accidents/#:~:text=Matthew%20Berenger.%20Principal%20Director%20%E2%80%93%20Accredited%20Specialist,Bechelli.%20Senior%20Associate%20%E2%80%93%20Personal%20Injury%20Law.)

Most personal injury lawyers operate on a **"No Win, No Fee"** basis (though you should always check the fine print regarding out-of-pocket expenses like medical reports).[www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/nsw/newcastle/#:~:text=Start%20your%20FREE%20claim%20check%20or%20call,for%20NSW%20workers%20compensation%20matters.%20*%20Call.)

### Prominent Local and Regional Law Firms in Newcastle

* **Whitelaw McDonald Lawyers:** A long-established local firm (based in Kotara/Newcastle) with extensive experience handling Hunter Valley and Newcastle motor vehicle accident claims, featuring Accredited Specialists in Personal Injury Law.[wmcdlaw.com.au](https://wmcdlaw.com.au/compensation-law/car-accidents/#:~:text=Matthew%20Berenger.%20Principal%20Director%20%E2%80%93%20Accredited%20Specialist,Bechelli.%20Senior%20Associate%20%E2%80%93%20Personal%20Injury%20Law.)
* **Turner Freeman Lawyers:** Highly regarded and nationally recognized (including rankings in *Doyle's Guide* for motor vehicle accident compensation law in NSW) with a dedicated local presence in Newcastle.[www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/office/newcastle/)
* **Conrad Curry Lawyer:** A well-known local firm specializing in personal injury and car accident compensation in the Newcastle and Hunter region.

### Major National Firms with Newcastle Offices

* **Shine Lawyers (Newcastle Office):** Located on King Street, they handle a broad range of motor vehicle and CTP claims.[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/nsw/newcastle#:~:text=As%20part%20of%20our%20national%20team%2C%20Shine,child%2C%20including%20historical%20child%20sex%20abuse%20compensation.)
* **GMP Law (Gerard Malouf & Partners):** Located on Tudor Street, they are a large personal injury firm handling CTP and motor vehicle accident claims.[www.gerardmaloufpartners.com.au](https://www.gerardmaloufpartners.com.au/locations/newcastle/#:~:text=Newcastle's%20experts%20in%20personal%20injury%20claims.%20GMP,striving%20to%20secure%20the%20maximum%20compensation%20possible.)
* **LHD Lawyers:** Located on Bolton Street, they service the Hunter region for motor vehicle accidents and NSW CTP claims.[www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/nsw/newcastle/#:~:text=Injured%20in%20a%20Hunter%20region%20car%20accident%3F,driver%20was%20at%20fault.%20Find%20out%20more.)
* **Law Advice:** Also situated on Bolton Street in Newcastle, offering specialized motor vehicle and personal injury claim support.[www.lawadvice.com.au](https://www.lawadvice.com.au/office/newcastle#:~:text=Our%20Newcastle%20office%20is%20located%20at%2017,uncertainty%20that%20follows%20an%20injury%20or%20accident.)

---

### Tips Before You Contact a Lawyer:

1.  **Check for Accredited Specialists:** Look for lawyers who are **Accredited Specialists in Personal Injury Law** through the Law Society of NSW.[www.lawadvice.com.au](https://www.lawadvice.com.au/office/newcastle#:~:text=Our%20proven%20track%20record%20and%20satisfied%20clients,your%20case%20gets%20the%20attention%20it%20deserves.) This ensures they have formal, certified expertise in handling complex injury compensation.
2.  **Understand "No Win, No Fee":** Clarify what happens if your case is unsuccessful. While legal fees are usually waived if you lose, you may still be responsible for third-party "disbursements" (like medical reports or expert witness fees).[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/nsw/newcastle#:~:text=If%20your%20case%20is%20unsuccessful%2C%20you%20won't,lawyer%20for%20your%20compensation%20claim%20is%20important.)
3.  **Mind the Time Limits:** In NSW, CTP claims generally need to be lodged within specific timeframes (often within 28 days to secure backdated benefits for treatment and lost income, and strict limits for lump-sum common law claims), so it is wise to consult a lawyer promptly.
